title: Pre-existing type error: StudyActivityChart.tsx recharts module
body: src/app/(frontend)/stats/_components/StudyActivityChart.tsx may show 'Cannot find module recharts' type errors if node_modules becomes corrupted. Fix: run `pnpm install` to ensure recharts is properly installed.
rationale: This is a node_modules issue, not a code issue. Running pnpm install after any clean install resolves it.
